prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object is approached, take it and move to destination, check properties, do the task. Otherwise, approach or scan. list of available nodes: <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToDestination    /> <Action ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> <Action ID = SpecificTask    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
		DO MoveToDestination
			IF CheckObjectProperties? THEN
			DO SpecificTask
	END
